summary: Focus on 20th-century US history; pre-modern topics show zero traction.
Avoid abstract or vague titles; use specific, high-stakes narrative hooks.
Ensure retention by front-loading the 'why it matters' hook in the first 30 seconds.
Target 300+ second average duration; under 200 seconds signals poor pacing.
Prioritize rescue, mystery, or conflict-driven narratives over general history.
If a video has 0 views after 3 days, pivot the topic immediately.
